**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 74 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 2 --- This staff is made of a dense wood and strikes the ground with an imposing boom. At the top of the staff is a perfectly round obsidian sphere that, when stared at for too long, makes viewers feel as though they're heavier than before. When wielding this staff, you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against [forced movement](/Rules.aspx?ID=451). **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells. Atmospheric Staff (Lesser) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 74 **Price** 95 gp **Bulk** 2 ---
  • **Cantrip** [_gale blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=917)
  • **1st** [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=5), [_gravitational pull_](/Spells.aspx?ID=921)
Atmospheric Staff **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 74 **Price** 480 gp **Bulk** 2 ---
  • **2nd** [_gentle breeze_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1316)
  • **3rd** [_gravity well_](/Spells.aspx?ID=577), [_tempest cloak_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1323)
Atmospheric Staff (Greater) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 74 **Price** 1,900 gp **Bulk** 2 ---
  • **4th** [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=125), [_variable gravity_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1026)
  • **5th** [_elemental form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=98) (air only), [_telekinetic haul_](/Spells.aspx?ID=332)
Atmospheric Staff (Major) **Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 74 **Price** 8,900 gp **Bulk** 2 ---
  • **6th** [_zero gravity_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1035)
  • **7th** _elemental form_ (air only), [_vacuum_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1324)
